_doc: Reusable defaults for every piece. Piece presets layer on top of this file; never hand-edit values here for one piece.

motion._doc: overscan: how much larger than the frame the source is prepared, so push and drift never expose an edge. zoom eases from zoom_start to zoom_end across the whole piece (slow push). drift_* is total pan in px across the piece. wobble is a barely visible breathing so a still never feels frozen. parallax: 0..1, how much less the buried layer moves than the surface.

vfx._doc: All times are seconds relative to the cue frame. Negative = before the cue.

light._doc: hit: intensity on the cue frame itself (hard step so the reveal is on-frame). attack: seconds to reach full. decay: seconds to settle to sustain. color: linear RGB 0..1 of the light. strength: overall amount. gain: how much the stone's own texture is multiplied up at full strength (keeps grain). tint: how much of the light colour is added on top. halo: soft spill around the shape.

crack._doc: A jagged fracture from from_edge to the centroid of the hidden shape, drawn over `draw` seconds starting on the cue frame.

chromatic._doc: RGB channel split in px on the cue frame, easing back to 0 over `length` seconds.

grain._doc: Film grain as a fraction of full scale. base runs the whole piece; spike is added on the cue and fades over spike_length.

tremor._doc: Anticipation: extra grain flicker growing over `lead` seconds before the cue.

flash._doc: Whole-frame lift on the cue, fading over length. Keep tiny: the light on the shape should carry the reveal, not a white flash.
